name: Demon Ship

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

disable: DC 20 Religion check (trained) to ward against demonic presence, DC 20 Arcana check (trained) or DC 20 Occultism check (trained) to weaken the demonic possession, DC 20 Intimidation check (trained) to scare it away, or DC 18 Sailing-lore check (trained) to confuse it; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
routine:
2 The demon ship uses its actions on one of the following options (GM's choice). It loses one action from its routine if a PC succeeds at an attempt to Disable it or it reaches its Broken Threshold.
- Broadside Blast a The demon ship makes a Chthonian cannon Strike.
- Demonic List d Effect The ship tosses and turns. Each creature in the hazard's area must make a DC 20 Reflex save save. On a failure, it is knocked Prone; on a critical failure it also takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage.
- Heads Will Roll a It makes a bowsprit Strike.
- Sea Chantey a (auditory) All fiends within 60 feet gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear effects; all non-fiends within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 20 Will save save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).
